tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: What Airfare Brain covers: airlines, how fees are researched and dated, what it does NOT do (no live fares, no booking), and the sister tool for car hire.

tools.name: list_airlines
tools.description: List every airline with a fee table: name, IATA code, the date its fees were checked, and its page.

tools.name: airline_fees
tools.description: One airline's published extra fees (bags, seats, priority, check-in, changes, payment), each with the price range, when bought (at booking / later / airport), how it is charged, its source URL and the date checked. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: true_cost
tools.description: The true cost of a flight on one airline. Pass `fare` (the total for the whole party, from a flight-search tool or the person) to get fare + extras; without it you get the extras alone. Extras = what the person chooses (cabin bag, checked bag by kg, seat, priority, infants) for their party and trip,

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: airline_fees · Public sink: true_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: airline_fees · Public sink: true_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
